palette.notes: Measured palette_size 3 (black field dominates; the small sprite's colours count as rare), 1 ramp, hue shift 0. Visually: pure black ground, emerald-to-mint greens for the costume and glow, skin and hair accents.

lighting: The ring is the light source: a green glow on the hand lights the hero's front from inside an otherwise black frame. Ends on a full green flash and a glowing emblem that fades to black.
silhouette: Small sprite on black: arm extended forward with the glowing ring is the readable pose; costume swaps (different Lanterns) keep the same pose silhouette.

motion.timing: Code: 114 changes in 19.37 s, 5.89 drawings/s, hold median 33.3 ms (p25 and p75 the same), on 1s. Character-swap beats roughly every 1.6 s on the sheet, then flash, emblem, fade.

texture: Clean low-res sprite (clean_pixels true, dither 0.0001) on flat black; soft additive glow halo around the ring; flat green fill with soft emblem glow at the end.
camera: Static. The sprite is placed small in the middle, later shifted lower; the reveal is a full-frame colour flash, then a centred emblem.
sound: Caption: the oath animation, so the beats are timed to the spoken oath.

acting.enters: Each Lantern fades or cuts in already in the same ring-out pose; one figure turns into the next.
acting.acts: Hold the ring out, glow pulses; the cast cycles through several characters on the same mark, ending with one raising the ring overhead.
acting.exits: Characters dissolve into the next one; the last one is wiped by a full green flash.
acting.depth: One plane, small figure in a huge black field; scale comes only from the full-screen emblem at the end.

techniques: match cut: same pose, swap the character
glow as the only light in a black frame
small sprite in negative space so the glow reads
full-frame colour flash to transition to the logo
emblem reveal then slow fade to black as the button
feel: black void + small sprite + green ring glow + same-pose character swaps = epic oath on a tiny budget
for_fred: Use the same-pose swap: Fred and Pixie hit the identical pose on the same mark and the reel cuts between them on the beat, then a full-colour flash into the logo. Keep the sprite small and give it one glowing prop as the light source so it reads on a dark frame.
